risks: AI 基礎設施資本支出長期看多，可能引發短線技術性反彈或資金快速回補。
地緣政治與能源價格波動（如中東局勢）可能推升通膨並對風險資產造成額外壓力。
invalidation_conditions: QQQ 與 SMH 帶量收復 20 日均線並扭轉 20 日負報酬結構。
VIX 指數顯著回落且市場廣度全面轉為多頭排列。

arguments: 根據 Yahoo Finance 資料，市場快照顯示 SPY 20 日報酬 -0.018895% 且低於 50 日均線 -0.536669%，宏觀趨勢判定為 risk_off，VIX 水平為 18.209999。
個股與板塊表現承壓，AMD 單日重挫 -8.148301%、PLTR 下跌 -6.082263%，反映高 Beta 資產正面臨顯著修正壓力。
地緣政治風險與能源供應疑慮持續存在，根據 Google Search grounding 驗證之摘要（ev_geopolitics_oil），美伊衝突對荷姆茲海峽的能源及供應鏈構成潛在潛在尾部風險。
risks: 雖然 AI 基礎設施的長期資本支出（如預期 2026 年大型科技公司資本支出達到約 7250 億美元，ev_tech_capex_ai）提供了強大的基本面支撐，但短期之內總體經濟與市場情緒偏向 risk_off。
Yahoo Finance 資料可能存在延遲，且歷史現金防守之成效僅代表過去單日表現，不得推論為未來必然獲得正報酬。
invalidation_conditions: SPY 重新站回 50 日均線之上且市場趨勢由 risk_off 轉為 risk_on。
VIX 顯著回落且高 Beta 板塊（如半導體與科技股）止穩回升，滾動視窗樣本達標。

arguments: 根據已提供的市場快照與證據，總體市場趨勢處於 risk_off 狀態，且標普 500 指數低於 50 日均線。
主要科技與半導體相關標的（如 AMD 下跌 8.15%、PLTR 下跌 6.08%）近期面臨顯著回檔壓力與高波動性（AMD 20日波動率達 79.9%）。
依據現有的 13F、Form 4 與相關 filing 事件，機構持股與內部人交易資訊顯示市場正處於防守與調整階段，缺乏即時的強多頭支撐。
risks: 現有樣本視窗（distinct_completed_sessions）尚未完全滿足 3 與 7 個交易日完整滾動視窗的政策門檻。
總體資本支出數據（如 AI 基礎設施巨額投入）可能在長期帶來基本面支撐，但短期無法消除當前的技術面回檔與回撤風險。
現金配置雖能防禦短期波動，但在市場快速反彈時可能面臨機會成本。
invalidation_conditions: 市場趨勢由 risk_off 轉為 risk_on，且主要指數突破 50 日均線並站穩。
完成交易日的滾動視窗樣本數達到政策要求，且驗證出具備統計顯著性的正報酬表現。
重要申報文件（如 13F 或 Form 4）顯示機構與內部人出現大規模且持續的公開市場買超訊號。

arguments: 目前滾動視窗樣本數仍未達標（3 與 7 個完成交易日之 completed_windows 數量為 0），依政策規定需維持 fail_closed_symbol 為 CASH。
市場快照顯示科技與半導體板塊（如 SMH、SOXL、QQQ）遭遇顯著回檔，而 VIX 處於 18.21 之正常至偏高水位，風險資產回撤壓力尚未解除。
上一輪 100% CASH 策略成功在科技重挫期間發揮絕對防守效果，保護 6,000 美元初始資金免受路徑磨損與回檔衝擊。
risks: 若市場情緒快速反轉，全面現金配置將錯失短線反彈行情。
短線滾動視窗樣本數不足，無法統計跨日勝率與累積邊際效益。

arguments: SPY 20 日報酬為 -0.018895% 且低於 50 日均線 -0.536669%，顯示大盤整體處於弱勢整理的 risk_off 狀態。
科技與半導體板塊遭遇強烈賣壓，SMH 20 日報酬達 -16.199881% 且遠低於 20 日與 50 日均線，RSI14 僅剩 33.28，技術面呈現空頭排列。
高槓桿半導體 ETF 如 SOXL 在 2026-07-28 單日大跌 14.52%，20 日波動率高達 169.65%，反映出極端的回撤風險與劇烈路徑磨損。

critiques.strongest_objection: 所有代理人一致建議 100% 現金配置 (CASH)，且滾動視窗樣本數（3 與 7 個完成交易日）尚未達標（completed_windows 為 0），因此依據短視窗政策必須強制採用 fail_closed_symbol (CASH)，這在合規上是正確的。然而，部分代理人在論述中將短期的單日跌幅與歷史防守成效混為長期勝率推論，忽略了現金配置雖然規避了當前波動，但仍需嚴格受資料截止時間、交易摩擦與無風險資產機會成本的檢驗。
hidden_assumptions: 假設 100% 現金配置在任何短期內皆能完全零成本且無條件免疫宏觀或地緣政治的隔夜跳空風險。
假設當前資料截止時間（2026-07-29T01:10:51.913502Z）後的下一個交易日開盤不會發生顯著的流動性斷層或流動性摩擦。
假設現有的 3 與 7 日滾動視窗樣本數為 0 的狀態下，維持 CASH 屬於唯一合規的防禦解，不需再額外計算現金在通膨環境下的實質購買力耗損。
required_changes: 所有代理人未來在評估時，必須明確標註資料來源為已完成交易日（2026-07-28），絕不能使用未完成的盤中快照數據作為決策依據。
必須嚴格遵守短期績效政策，在 3 與 7 個完成交易日的滾動視窗樣本數達到門檻前，全面維持 fail_closed_symbol（CASH），不得因單日行情反彈而提前解除防守。
在後續報告中必須具體量化維持現金水位所產生的交易摩擦、機會成本與隔夜跳空情境風險，不得僅以空泛的 risk_off 做為全面防守的唯一理由。

critiques.strongest_objection: 多數共識完全依賴短期單日的大跌與技術破位（如 SOXL 重挫 14.52%、SMH 下跌 3.45%）作為全盤採取 risk_off 並 100% 配置 CASH 的充分理由，完全忽視了樣本嚴重不足的盲點。根據資料，completed_windows 數量為 0，且政策硬性規定必須有分別達 3 與 7 個完成交易日的滾動視窗及最小正報酬率門檻；在完全沒有統計顯著性支撐的情況下，多數共識以『防守』為名直接否決一切風險資產，違反了政策所要求的實證標準，將單日雜訊錯誤推論為長天期體制。
hidden_assumptions: 假設單一交易日的劇烈回檔（2026-07-28）足以代表未來 3 至 7 個完整交易日的市場路徑方向。
假設 100% 現金配置在面對長天期滾動視窗樣本不足時，其保守防禦行為自動符合所有風控合規要求，無需等待實質視窗達標。
假設目前 Yahoo Finance 所擷取的價格與技術指標（如 SPY 20日報酬率 -0.018895%）在沒有官方交易所完整饋送驗證下絕對正確且無延遲偏誤。
required_changes: 在 3 個與 7 個完成交易日的滾動視窗樣本數正式達到政策門檻（minimum_completed_windows_before_risk）之前，所有 Bearish 觀點必須在結論中明確標示為『樣本不足下的防禦性假設』，不得宣稱策略已經過統計驗證。
修正各代理人論述中將單日行情點充當完整視窗評估的邏輯錯誤，嚴格落實 policy 規定的 3 與 7 個完成交易日滾動計算。
重新評估全面 100% CASH 配置帶來的機會成本，並在下次審查中加入若市場反彈的錯失風險量化指標。

source_catalog.name: SEC EDGAR submissions and Company Facts
source_catalog.cadence: Real time as filings are disseminated
source_catalog.typical_latency: Usually under one minute for XBRL; filing metadata typically under one second
limitations: As-filed data can contain issuer errors or amended facts
XBRL concepts and fiscal periods are not perfectly comparable across issuers

source_catalog.name: SEC Forms 3, 4 and 5
source_catalog.typical_latency: Most Form 4 transactions are due within two business days
source_catalog.intended_use: Insider ownership changes and open-market purchase or sale context
limitations: Transaction codes must distinguish purchases, sales, grants, exercises, gifts and tax withholding
A filing is not proof that an insider trade predicts future returns

source_catalog.name: SEC Form 13F data sets
source_catalog.typical_latency: Up to 45 days after quarter end
source_catalog.intended_use: Slow-moving institutional holdings, concentration and quarter-over-quarter changes
limitations: Not a real-time institutional flow signal
Does not reveal every asset, short position, hedge or intra-quarter trade
As-filed records can contain filer errors and confidential-treatment omissions

source_catalog.name: Issuer investor-relations releases
source_catalog.intended_use: Earnings releases, guidance, presentations and material company events cross-checked with EDGAR
limitations: Issuer materials are management communications and may emphasize favorable framing
Use SEC filings as the canonical record when disclosures differ

source_catalog.name: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED and ALFRED
source_catalog.typical_latency: Series dependent; many observations are revised
source_catalog.intended_use: Rates, credit spreads, labor, inflation, liquidity and financial conditions
limitations: FRED combines many original publishers with different calendars
Use ALFRED vintages for backtests to avoid look-ahead from later revisions

source_catalog.name: U.S. Treasury daily yield curve
source_catalog.intended_use: Risk-free curve level, slope and rate-shock context
limitations: Par yields are model-derived curve points, not executable trade prices

source_catalog.name: Federal Reserve FOMC calendar, statements and projections
source_catalog.intended_use: Policy-event risk, rate decisions, minutes and Summary of Economic Projections
limitations: Projections are conditional participant forecasts with substantial uncertainty

source_catalog.name: NYSE trading hours and holiday calendar
source_catalog.intended_use: Determine regular sessions, holidays, early closes and whether a daily bar is complete
limitations: Calendar data does not provide prices or guarantee data-vendor bar finality
Provider integration is not active yet; the current 16:15 ET cutoff is only a conservative fallback

source_catalog.name: Cboe VIX Index and methodology
source_catalog.intended_use: Option-implied S&P 500 volatility regime and tail-risk context
limitations: VIX is not a direct forecast of portfolio loss
Mean reversion and futures term structure matter for VIX-linked products

source_catalog.name: Cboe VIX term structure
source_catalog.intended_use: Compare VIX9D, VIX, VIX3M, VIX6M and VIX1Y for event stress and volatility-curve regime
limitations: Index levels are not direct executable hedging costs
A single curve snapshot requires timestamp alignment with the portfolio decision

source_catalog.name: OCC exchange option volume and open interest
source_catalog.intended_use: Options activity and open-interest context for crowding, hedging demand and event risk
limitations: Aggregated volume does not identify investor intent or directional exposure
Open interest must be combined with strike, expiry and underlying context

source_catalog.name: FINRA short-interest and short-sale-volume data
source_catalog.cadence: Daily short-sale volume; short interest twice monthly
source_catalog.intended_use: Short positioning background and off-exchange short-sale activity
limitations: Daily short-sale volume is not short interest
Daily files cover reported off-exchange activity and are not consolidated with all exchanges
Short-sale volume can include positions closed on the same day

source_catalog.name: CFTC Commitments of Traders
source_catalog.typical_latency: Usually Friday release for Tuesday positions
source_catalog.intended_use: Futures positioning in equity indexes, rates, energy, metals and currencies
limitations: Aggregated categories are not security-specific equity fund flows
The usual Tuesday-to-Friday delay limits short-horizon timing use

source_catalog.name: U.S. Energy Information Administration Open Data
source_catalog.cadence: Daily, weekly, monthly or annual by series
source_catalog.intended_use: Oil prices, inventories, production, imports, exports and refinery utilization
limitations: Weekly estimates can be revised and may not align with equity-market timestamps

source_catalog.name: U.S. Treasury OFAC, USTR and Federal Register
source_catalog.intended_use: Sanctions, tariffs and regulatory actions with direct company or sector exposure
limitations: Official actions do not capture every geopolitical development or market interpretation
Company exposure mapping requires verified issuer geography and supply-chain data

source_catalog.name: Yahoo Finance via yfinance
source_catalog.intended_use: Price, volume and deterministic trend or volatility features
limitations: Not an official exchange feed
Corporate-action adjustments and occasional missing observations require validation

research_evidence.title: U.S. 2026 Real GDP Growth Forecast
research_evidence.summary: The U.S. economy is projected to grow at a moderate pace, with real GDP forecasts for 2026 ranging from 1.9% to 2.3% driven by consumer spending and business investment.
research_evidence.market_relevance: Provides a baseline macroeconomic growth context for assessing U.S. equity valuations and sector rotation.

research_evidence.title: Federal Funds Rate Target Maintenance
research_evidence.summary: The Federal Reserve has maintained the federal funds rate target range at 3.50% to 3.75% since the beginning of the year, with markets pricing in potential hikes.
research_evidence.market_relevance: Affects borrowing costs, fixed income strategies, and overall equity market multiple pricing.

research_evidence.title: Major Tech Companies AI Capital Expenditures
research_evidence.summary: Four major tech giants are projected to reach approximately $725 billion in total capital expenditures in 2026, with an estimated 75% dedicated to AI infrastructure.
research_evidence.market_relevance: Drives massive spending streams for data center providers, semiconductor manufacturers, and specialized hardware companies.

research_evidence.title: TSMC Expands Arizona Investment
research_evidence.summary: TSMC is investing an additional $100 billion in Arizona, bringing its total U.S. investment to approximately $265 billion focusing on advanced process technologies.
research_evidence.market_relevance: Significantly alters the domestic U.S. semiconductor supply chain landscape and advanced chip fabrication capacity.

research_evidence.title: Taiwan Economic Growth Revision for 2026
research_evidence.summary: Taiwan's economic growth forecast for 2026 has been significantly revised upward, with projections ranging from 9.4% to 10.38% driven by AI exports.
research_evidence.market_relevance: Reflects immense global demand for high-performance computing and advanced semiconductor manufacturing components.

research_evidence.title: South Korea Growth Outlook and Semiconductor Exports
research_evidence.summary: South Korea's economic growth outlook for 2026 has been revised upwards to 3.0%, with strong semiconductor exports fueled by AI demand serving as the primary driver.
research_evidence.market_relevance: Demonstrates the broad international spillover of global AI infrastructure spending into Asian exporting economies.

research_evidence.title: U.S. Private Sector Payrolls and Wages
research_evidence.summary: Private sector payrolls averaged 88,000 in the first half of 2026, while the Employment Cost Index increased 3.4% year-over-year in Q1 2026.
research_evidence.market_relevance: Provides critical signals regarding labor market health, consumer purchasing capacity, and inflationary wage pressures.

research_evidence.title: Middle East Tensions and Energy Risks
research_evidence.summary: Ongoing confrontations between the U.S. and Iran raise risks for energy prices, shipping lanes, and global supply chains in the Strait of Hormuz.
research_evidence.market_relevance: Creates potential upside volatility for energy commodities and acts as a primary tail risk for global inflation indices.

lessons.title: 3 與 7 個完成交易日滾動視窗樣本仍未達標
lessons.evidence: 根據確定性計算證據，distinct_completed_sessions 為 2，而 3 個完成交易日的 completed_windows 數量為 0，7 個完成交易日的 completed_windows 數量亦為 0。
lessons.implication: 政策明確規定必須分別使用 3 與 7 個完成交易日的滾動視窗進行評估，目前樣本視窗數不足，無法判定策略跨多日之優勢，因此學習判定必須維持 too_early。

lessons.title: 100% 現金策略在科技重挫期間發揮絕對防守效果
lessons.evidence: 在 2026-07-28 交易日中，QQQ 下跌 0.97%、SMH 大跌 3.45%、SOXL 重挫 14.52%，而上一輪策略維持 100% CASH（報酬率 0%），成功規避了高 Beta 科技與半導體資產的劇烈拉回與路徑磨損。
lessons.implication: 當市場處於科技與半導體板塊顯著回檔且波動率處於高位時，維持零風險水位可有效保護本金免受回撤，可作為低確定性環境下的標準防禦範本。

lessons.title: 單日價格變動與未成交假設不得替代完整視窗績效
lessons.evidence: 儘管 2026-07-28 盤面顯示 SQQQ 上漲 2.85%、QQQ 下跌，但因上一輪配置嚴格維持 100% CASH，且未進行實際或假設性的槓桿／反向加碼，任何盤中雜訊或未成交猜測皆不能計入策略淨報酬。
lessons.implication: 委員會必須嚴格區分可重複教訓與單次雜訊，日後檢驗必須嚴守完成收盤價與完整交易日視窗，絕不以外推單日估值點或未確認成交替代。

committee_changes: 委員會後續審查必須嚴格核對 distinct_completed_sessions 是否達到 3 與 7 個完整交易日，在達到政策門檻前一律標記 too_early。
維持零風險水位（100% CASH）的條件不變，直到市場跨日宏觀趨勢、波動率期限結構與交易成本全面納入確定性計算模型中。
每次事後驗證必須明確分開記錄 3 日與 7 日滾動視窗的完成數與正報酬數，不得混淆單日價格變動或盤中快照。
learning.member_assessment: Learning 委員已根據最新的市場收盤數據與確定性計算證據完成事後驗證。由於完整 3 日與 7 日滾動視窗之完成數仍為 0，依據政策規範，本輪驗證結果判定為 too_early。100% CASH 策略在 2026-07-28 科技股大跌期間成功發揮避險效果。
learning.skill_assessment: 系統運作正常，無需額外建立 Codex skill。現有的 JSON 結構化知識庫與自動化驗證流程已能精確執行 3 與 7 日視窗的稽核與教訓歸因。
